question:
(i) Define an electric dipole and electric dipole moment. State the direction and SI unit of electric dipole moment.
(ii) An electric dipole consists of charges $+4\,\mu\text{C}$ and $-4\,\mu\text{C}$ separated by $3\,\text{cm}$. Calculate the magnitude of its dipole moment.

options.A:
(i) Dipole: two equal charges of the same sign; $p=\frac{q}{d}$, directed from positive to negative, unit $\text{C m}^{-1}$
(ii) $p=1.2\times10^{-8}\,\text{C m}$
options.B:
(i) Dipole: any two charges; $p=qd^2$, no direction, unit $\text{C m}^2$
(ii) $p=1.2\times10^{-6}\,\text{C m}$
options.C:
(i) Dipole: equal and opposite charges; $p=qd$, directed from positive to negative, unit $\text{C m}$
(ii) $p=7.0\times10^{-6}\,\text{C m}$
options.D:
(i) Dipole: equal and opposite charges separated by a small distance; $p=qd$, directed from negative to positive, unit $\text{C m}$
(ii) $p=1.2\times10^{-7}\,\text{C m}$
